title: Grateful Dead Live at Monterey Fairgrounds on 1967-06-18
source: Lineage:  SBD Master Reels > DAT (Panasonic 3700) > Delta DiO 2496 > PC hard drive > CDR > CDWAV > Cool Edit > Traders Little Helper

ai_review.summary: Clean soundboard capture of a historic 1967 set with lively jamming, highlighted by Jerry’s Viola Lee Blues performance.
ai_review.review: The recording offers a surprisingly clear and well‑balanced soundboard source for a 1967 Monterey appearance, letting listeners hear the band’s informal, genre‑hopping vibe.  While the set isn’t hailed as a classic masterpiece, the jamming is solid and Jerry Garcia’s Viola Lee Blues moment draws particular praise.  Overall the audio quality exceeds many contemporaneous releases, making it a valuable historical document.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the show 3‑5 stars and praise both the musical performance and the clean soundboard recording; only a few low‑star notes are unrelated to the audio itself.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Several reviewers call the source "very nice and clean" and note it sounds better than other available recordings, with a clear mix that has been nicely cleaned up.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is described as informal and varied, mixing psychedelic jams with blues and country‑flavored tunes; overall it flows well enough to be enjoyable even if not a landmark performance.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Highlighted for his Viola Lee Blues playing and a brief George Harrison‑style stage gesture.
